schema_errors_note: Checked with a local ad-hoc validator (/tmp/son55/validate.py): required fields, 35 expectations per record, 8 ratings keys, status/rating consistency, score recomputation, parent-child checks against PARENTS.tsv and taxonomy.json, evidence quote presence, dangling evidence ids. This is structure/arithmetic only, not a semantic check and not the official validator.

input_drift.detail: fulltext files for these papers were replaced on disk at 13:16 EDT (after the 12:15 manifest); materials.jsonl was updated with new hashes. Records remain bound to the manifest hash that was read; see materials[0].input_drift in each record.

session_ref_note: No session id/receipt is exposed to this subagent.

contamination.note: Only fixed fulltext, the 13 shared reference fulltexts (a handful of lines of 2306.06070, 2401.10935, 2404.07972, 2405.14573, 2501.12326, 2307.13854 used as fact sources), manifest, rules, cards, taxonomy/conditions and expectations were read. Same-batch papers were cross-referenced only for lineage/baseline numbers (no scores).

caveats: Ratings use the draft_uncalibrated rubric; no anchors were frozen. Scores are mechanical sums of the eight ratings.
Evidence level / claim_support are independent judgements; all numbers are author-reported (our_inference only where recomputed from the author tables; no our_run).

Original sources of several nearest neighbours (WGE, DOM-Q-NET, World of Bits, WebN-T5, Synapse, AdaPlanner, Seq2Act, Screen2Words, ReAct, Reflexion, Self-Refine) are not in the pinned bundle; lineage statements about them are author-relayed.
